description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the “Activated Parameters Ratio (%)” on the x-axis and the “Eval PPL” (Evaluation Perplexity) on the y-axis for four different model configurations from the Mixture of Hidden-Dimensions Transformer paper. The x-axis is linear, ranging from 100% to 25% in decrements of 25%, labeled as “Activated Parameters Ratio (%)”. The y-axis is linear, ranging from approximately 11.5 to 14.0, labeled “Eval PPL”, with major gridlines at intervals of 0.5. Four lines are plotted: “Transformer” (red dashed line with no markers) remains nearly flat, starting at ~11.6 at 100% and ending at ~11.7 at 25%; “Only MoHD FFN” (gray square markers with solid line) starts at ~11.6 at 100%, dips slightly to ~11.5 at 75%, then rises to ~11.8 at 50% and ~11.9 at 25%; “Only MoHD ATTN” (dark blue circle markers with solid line) begins at ~11.6 at 100%, increases to ~11.7 at 75%, ~12.2 at 50%, and sharply rises to ~14.0 at 25%; “MoHD ATTN + MLP” (light blue star markers with solid line) starts at ~11.6 at 100%, rises gradually to ~11.7 at 75%, ~12.1 at 50%, and reaches ~13.1 at 25%. All lines show increasing perplexity as parameter activation decreases, with “Only MoHD ATTN” exhibiting the steepest degradation at low activation ratios.
